sentences.pt: Sábado de manhã, Dona Lúcia vai à feira.
sentences.en: On Saturday morning, Mrs. Lúcia goes to the street market.

sentences.pt: Ela tem setenta anos e adora frutas.
sentences.en: She is seventy years old and loves fruit.

sentences.pt: Ela leva cinquenta reais na bolsa.
sentences.en: She takes fifty reais in her bag.

sentences.pt: Primeiro, ela compra um quilo de tomate.
sentences.en: First, she buys a kilo of tomatoes.

sentences.pt: O tomate custa oito reais.
sentences.en: The tomatoes cost eight reais.

sentences.pt: Depois, ela compra seis bananas por cinco reais.
sentences.en: Then she buys six bananas for five reais.

sentences.pt: "Quanto custa a laranja?", ela pergunta ao vendedor.
sentences.en: "How much are the oranges?" she asks the seller.

sentences.pt: "Vinte reais dois quilos, senhora", ele responde.
sentences.en: "Twenty reais for two kilos, ma'am," he answers.

sentences.pt: "Que caro!", diz Dona Lúcia.
sentences.en: "How expensive!" says Mrs. Lúcia.

sentences.pt: Mas ela compra dois quilos, porque o neto adora suco de laranja.
sentences.en: But she buys two kilos, because her grandson loves orange juice.

sentences.pt: No fim, ela compra um queijo por doze reais.
sentences.en: At the end, she buys a cheese for twelve reais.

sentences.pt: Ela paga tudo e conta o dinheiro.
sentences.en: She pays for everything and counts her money.

sentences.pt: Ela ainda tem cinco reais.
sentences.en: She still has five reais.

sentences.pt: Com o dinheiro, ela bebe um suco gelado.
sentences.en: With the money, she drinks a cold juice.

sentences.pt: Às onze horas, ela volta para casa, cansada mas feliz.
sentences.en: At eleven o'clock, she goes back home, tired but happy.

questions.qEn: How much do the tomatoes cost?

sentences.pt: Hoje Gabriel faz oito anos.
sentences.en: Today Gabriel turns eight.

sentences.pt: A festa vai começar às quatro horas da tarde.
sentences.en: The party is going to start at four in the afternoon.

sentences.pt: A mãe dele, Fernanda, está muito ocupada.
sentences.en: His mother, Fernanda, is very busy.

sentences.pt: Ela precisa de vinte copos, vinte pratos e um bolo grande.
sentences.en: She needs twenty cups, twenty plates and a big cake.

sentences.pt: Ela vai ao supermercado às duas horas.
sentences.en: She goes to the supermarket at two o'clock.

sentences.pt: Os copos e os pratos custam quinze reais.
sentences.en: The cups and the plates cost fifteen reais.

sentences.pt: O bolo custa sessenta reais.
sentences.en: The cake costs sixty reais.

sentences.pt: Ela também compra três litros de refrigerante e dois litros de suco.
sentences.en: She also buys three liters of soda and two liters of juice.

sentences.pt: Às três e meia, ela volta para casa.
sentences.en: At three thirty, she goes back home.

sentences.pt: Os amigos de Gabriel chegam às quatro.
sentences.en: Gabriel's friends arrive at four.

sentences.pt: São doze crianças na festa.
sentences.en: There are twelve children at the party.

sentences.pt: Eles brincam no jardim e comem muito.
sentences.en: They play in the garden and eat a lot.

sentences.pt: Às seis horas, todos cantam para Gabriel.
sentences.en: At six o'clock, everyone sings to Gabriel.

sentences.pt: O bolo é de chocolate, o favorito dele.
sentences.en: The cake is chocolate, his favorite.

sentences.pt: Às oito horas, a festa acaba e Gabriel dorme no sofá.
sentences.en: At eight o'clock, the party ends and Gabriel falls asleep on the sofa.

questions.qEn: How much does the cake cost?
How many children are at the party?
